title: Trace-formula coefficient conventions
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]
$p,a,q,k_0,k$, where $q=p^a$, a prime $\ell\neq p$, and a finite
extension $E/\Ql$ contained in a fixed algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of
$\Ql$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer
$\varpi_E$, and an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$. Put
$A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $X_0$ be a
separated finite-type
$k_0$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and write
$a_X:X\to s=\Spec k$ for its structure morphism, with geometric base change as in [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. On the
small pro-etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site],
use the bounded
constructible finite-torsion coefficient category $D^b_c(X,A)$ of [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] and
the finite-Tor subcategory
$D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], the
derived pullback, tensor
and internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the
cohomology sheaves of [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves], and
the compact-support
cohomology construction of [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]; in particular, for $K\in D^b_c(X,A)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$, define

$$
R\Gamma_c(X,K)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{X!}K),\qquad
H_c^i(X,K)=\mathrm H^i\bigl(R\Gamma_c(X,K)\bigr)
$$

with $\operatorname{Fib}_s:D^b_c(s,A)\to D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$ and the finite-coefficient categories over a point of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Here $\mathrm H^i$ is the cohomology module of the coefficient complex, as in [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology].
